notes.title: Balance change
notes.notes:
By popular demand, we have revised the balance of the mini-game. 
And simplify it, keeping the interest in the mini-game!

notes.title: The day of release!
notes.notes:
Today we finally show you our product!
We took into account the requests of the players from the last game and made a translation into Chinese, Japanese, and improved the translation into English!
In the future, we plan to add some story DLC for free!
We also took into account the requests of the players and completely refused censorship!
beautiful animated girls, with groans are waiting for you!
